snippet.title: 1000 Deaths - Official Release Date Trailer | IGN Live 2025
snippet.description: Get another look at gameplay and the surreal world of 1000 Deaths in this upcoming gravity-bending 3D platformer where your choices matter. What you choose defines the game's levels, mechanics, and story. Dash through platforming hubs and decide your character's fate while exploring surreal worlds. Speedrun, or don't! 1000 Deaths will be available on PC on August 7, 2025.
